items.title: illumin推出Ask Lu廣告助理，建案功能開放測試
items.summary: illumin宣布在全球逐步推出Ask Lu報表功能，團隊可對廣告數據提問，並將回答整理成報告。
highlights: Campaign Creation可參考過往廣告活動來建立和調整新活動，現為公開測試。
平台也開始在全球推出新版競價預測功能。
items.why: 代理商可以縮短從發現異常到提出調整方案的流程，仍可先核對數字再作決定。
items.next_step: 用已結案的活動比較Ask Lu與既有報表的花費和轉換數，再評估是否採用測試版建案。
items.detail: illumin表示，Ask Lu Reporting可將回答整理為摘要、報告及圖表。公司亦重建廣告競價前的預測機制，表示系統會納入更多因素以評估投放機會。兩項功能開始在全球推出，利用過往活動資料建立及調整活動的Campaign Creation則屬公開測試。媒體團隊可先選一個已知有異常的活動，核對工具能否指出差異發生在哪個環節。
items.title_en: illumin rolls out Ask Lu reporting and opens campaign creation beta
items.summary_en: illumin says it has begun rolling out Ask Lu Reporting globally. Teams can ask questions about their campaign data and turn answers into reports.
highlights_en: Campaign Creation can draw on earlier campaigns to build and refine new ones. It is in open beta.
The platform also began rolling out an updated pre-bid prediction system globally.
items.why_en: Agencies can shorten the path from spotting an anomaly to proposing a change while checking the numbers before acting.
items.next_step_en: Compare spend and conversions in Ask Lu with existing reports for a closed campaign before assessing the creation beta.
items.detail_en: illumin says Ask Lu Reporting can package answers into summaries, reports and charts. The company also rebuilt its pre-bid prediction system to consider more signals when assessing an ad opportunity. Both features are rolling out worldwide. Campaign Creation uses earlier campaign data to build and refine campaigns and remains in open beta. Media teams can use a campaign with a known anomaly to see if the assistant identifies where it arose.

items.title: 迪士尼與Visa在亞太合作，香港樂園擬推持卡人禮遇
items.summary: 迪士尼與Visa宣布在亞太重點市場展開多年合作，涵蓋聯名卡、持卡人禮遇及聯合行銷。
highlights: Visa將為合作涵蓋的迪士尼Visa聯名卡提供獨家支付網路。
香港迪士尼擬為合資格持卡人提供提早入園及指定娛樂優先權。
items.why: 品牌可把粉絲體驗與持卡禮遇綁在一起，為聯名產品提供可具體預期的使用情境。
items.next_step: 聯名合作團隊可先列出發卡方、場地及驗證資格所需資料，供正式條款公布後逐項核對。
items.detail: 雙方公布的香港迪士尼構想還包括指定的角色見面體驗。Visa亦將出任在新加坡舉行的D23 Asia粉絲活動首席贊助商，合資格持卡人可望獲預售機會。聯盟的參與市場、資格及推出時間仍待公布。規劃類似合作時，團隊可先確定每項禮遇由哪個合作方負責驗證及兌換。
items.title_en: Disney and Visa strike Asia-Pacific alliance with planned Hong Kong park perks
items.summary_en: Disney and Visa announced a multi-year alliance covering co-branded cards, cardholder benefits and joint marketing in key Asia-Pacific markets.
highlights_en: Visa will be the exclusive payment network for the Disney Visa co-brand programs covered by the alliance.
Planned perks for eligible cardholders at Hong Kong Disneyland include early entry and priority access to select entertainment.
items.why_en: Brands can tie fan experiences to cardholder perks to give customers a concrete reason to use the co-branded product.
items.next_step_en: List issuer, venue and eligibility data requirements so each can be checked once the terms are announced.
items.detail_en: The companies also outlined dedicated character encounters at Hong Kong Disneyland. Visa will be presenting sponsor of the D23 Asia fan event in Singapore, where eligible cardholders are expected to get presale access. Participating markets, eligibility and launch timing are still pending. Teams designing similar programs can decide who will validate and redeem each perk before promoting it.

items.title: Google將Gemini Tasks免費開放至六個市場
items.summary: Google公布，可在背景執行多步驟工作的Gemini Tasks，開始在六個市場免費推出。
highlights: 首批包括美國、印度、加拿大、澳洲、日本和南韓。
Google Pay結帳另在美國向合資格成人個人帳戶逐步推出英文版，須由用戶確認。
items.why: 電商團隊可檢查商品價格和庫存能否在搜尋、商品頁及結帳保持一致。
items.next_step: 選一批常缺貨商品，核對補貨狀態和價格上限在結帳前的顧客提示。
items.detail: Google表示，Gemini Tasks可執行多步驟或定期任務，並在結果就緒後通知使用者。另行推出的Google Pay結帳功能可在找到符合預算的商品後準備結帳，向用戶顯示明細並等待確認。六個市場的免費推出名單沒有香港，結帳功能的資格及語言範圍則按美國推出條款處理。
items.title_en: Google begins free rollout of Gemini Tasks in six markets
items.summary_en: Google says Gemini Tasks, which can handle multi-step work in the background, has begun rolling out for free in six markets.
highlights_en: The initial markets are the US, India, Canada, Australia, Japan and South Korea.
Google Pay checkout is rolling out separately in English to eligible US adults with personal accounts and requires user approval.
items.why_en: Commerce teams can check whether prices and inventory agree across search, product pages and checkout.
items.next_step_en: Pick frequently out-of-stock products and review how shoppers see restock status and price limits before checkout.
items.detail_en: Google says Gemini Tasks can take on multi-step or recurring work and tell users when results are ready. The separate Google Pay feature can stage checkout when it finds an item within budget, show an itemized summary and wait for approval. Hong Kong is outside the listed free rollout. The checkout rollout has its own US, language and eligibility limits.

items.title: 更進新聞：Microsoft在Foundry公開預覽MAI Image 2.7與Flash
items.summary: Microsoft公布兩款可生成及編輯圖片的模型，開放Foundry公開預覽，並在MAI Labs推出Canvas。
highlights: MAI Image 2.7及Flash均支援透明背景。
Canvas由Flash支援，可從草圖開始，選取局部調整。
items.why: 商品與品牌設計團隊可比較兩款模型在背景去除及局部修改時，能否保留包裝顏色和標誌細節。
items.next_step: 以同一組商品素材測試兩款模型，比對透明邊緣、標誌和連續修改後的色差。
items.detail: Microsoft表示，MAI Image 2.7可修改物件的位置、顏色或材質。Canvas提供同一工作空間，讓使用者從文字提示或草圖產生圖片，再選取局部處理。對照兩款模型時，可用相同參考圖檢查材質和形狀是否保留，再計算通過品牌審核的素材所需修改次數。
items.title_en: Update: Microsoft previews MAI Image 2.7 and Flash publicly in Foundry
items.summary_en: Microsoft announced two models for generating and editing images in Foundry public preview and launched Canvas in MAI Labs.
highlights_en: MAI Image 2.7 and Flash both support transparent backgrounds.
Canvas runs on Flash and can turn a sketch into an image that users can edit in selected areas.
items.why_en: Brand and product designers can compare how well both models preserve packaging colors and logo details during cutouts and local edits.
items.next_step_en: Test both models with the same product assets and compare transparent edges, logos and color drift after successive edits.
items.detail_en: Microsoft says MAI Image 2.7 can change an object's position, color or material. Canvas lets users turn a prompt or sketch into an image and select areas to revise in the same workspace. Compare both models using the same reference image, check whether materials and shapes hold up, and count the revisions needed to pass brand review.
items.followup: 10月29日本刊報道初期以圖像編輯為主的預覽。本次新增生成、Flash版本及Canvas工作空間。
items.followup_en: Our October 29 issue covered the earlier editing preview. This announcement adds generation, Flash and the Canvas workspace.

items.title: 霸王茶姬九周年為七個海外市場設計在地版Teadore
items.summary: 霸王茶姬在九周年首度把大象角色Teadore帶到海外，並為七個國際市場設計各自的版本。
highlights: 新加坡版本參考魚尾獅，馬來西亞版本採用娘惹服飾及大紅花元素。
品牌保留大象、茶葉形耳朵和品牌字母等識別，讓在地設計仍可辨認。
items.why: 跨市場行銷可預先決定哪些品牌元素要保留，並由當地團隊判斷哪些文化符號合適。
items.next_step: 為下一個區域活動做一頁素材指引，列明核心識別、可調整元素及各市場審核人。
items.detail: 霸王茶姬亞太區行銷主管向Marketing-Interactive表示，Teadore以品牌發源地雲南及茶馬古道為靈感。泰國版本以泰拳裝備呈現，韓國版本穿韓服。品牌將周年活動作為角色首次走進國際市場的機會，並打算讓角色納入長期品牌設計。地方團隊可核對服飾、顏色與象徵符號在不同市場的理解。
items.title_en: CHAGEE localizes anniversary mascot Teadore for seven international markets
items.summary_en: CHAGEE is taking its elephant mascot Teadore overseas for the first time for its ninth anniversary, with local designs for seven international markets.
highlights_en: Singapore's version draws on the Merlion, while Malaysia's uses a kebaya and hibiscus details.
The elephant, leaf-shaped ears and CHAGEE lettermark keep the mascot recognizable across local designs.
items.why_en: Regional teams can decide which brand elements to keep and ask local teams to review cultural references.
items.next_step_en: Create a one-page asset guide for the next regional campaign that lists core identifiers, adaptable elements and market reviewers.
items.detail_en: CHAGEE's APAC marketing chief told Marketing-Interactive that Teadore draws on Yunnan, where the brand started, and the Ancient Tea Horse Road. The Thai version wears Muay Thai gear and the Korean version wears a hanbok. The anniversary is the first overseas outing for a character CHAGEE intends to keep beyond this campaign. Local teams can check how their audiences interpret clothing, colors and symbols.

items.title: 更進新聞：Daydream推出穿搭助理，參與商戶支援一鍵結帳
items.summary: Daydream推出時裝購物助理，可按用戶的場合、尺碼偏好和預算建議搭配，並在背景追蹤商品。
highlights: 用戶可要求助理留意降價或品牌推出新品。
購買須顧客批准，一鍵結帳只適用參與商戶。
items.why: 時裝零售商可檢查尺寸、場合和庫存資料，讓商品有機會回應具體穿搭需求。
items.next_step: 逐項比對商品頁及商品資料源的尺碼名稱、價格及庫存，並查詢商戶結帳資格。
items.detail: Daydream表示，助理在iOS應用程式和短訊開放。顧客可把商品存入清單，比較配搭，並重複使用上載的照片作虛擬試穿。用戶同意後，助理亦可利用衣櫃和行事曆資訊作建議。對零售團隊而言，試穿、商品建議及結帳各有適用情境，可分開檢查商品資料和參與條件。
items.title_en: Update: Daydream launches styling agent with checkout at participating retailers
items.summary_en: Daydream launched a fashion shopping agent that suggests outfits by occasion, fit preferences and budget and can track products in the background.
highlights_en: Shoppers can ask the agent to watch for sales or new products from a brand.
One-click checkout is limited to participating partners and requires shopper approval.
items.why_en: Fashion retailers can check their fit, occasion and inventory data so products can answer more specific styling requests.
items.next_step_en: Compare sizing labels, prices and stock in your catalog feed with the product pages and ask whether your store is eligible for checkout.
items.detail_en: Daydream says the agent is available in its iOS app and by text. Shoppers can save items, compare outfits and reuse an uploaded photo for virtual try-on. With opt-in, the agent can also use closet and calendar information in suggestions. Retail teams can check catalog coverage and partner eligibility separately for try-on, recommendations and checkout.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.followup: 9月16日本刊報道Daydream從手機相簿找商品。這次加入持續追蹤、穿搭建議及參與商戶結帳。
items.followup_en: Our September 16 issue covered discovery from the camera roll. The new agent adds ongoing tracking, outfit suggestions and partner checkout.

items.title: 澳洲Bench Media在Bench Connect加入廣告分析助理Aura
items.summary: 澳洲媒體代理商Bench Media在Bench Connect推出Aura，讓行銷人員以英文查詢廣告活動數據。
highlights: Aura可協助比較不同投放平台的表現。
創意及成效團隊可分別追查素材疲勞跡象和獲客成本變化。
items.why: 媒體團隊可以先追查異常屬於單一受眾、素材或整個活動，再決定是否調整廣告。
items.next_step: 以已具基準數據的活動測試提問，並與各平台原始報表比對時間範圍及轉換定義。
items.detail: 據Mediaweek報道，Bench Connect彙集活動表現、受眾與廣告分析資料，Aura讓團隊以英文追問這些資料。Bench Media的產品主管以轉換上升為例，說明團隊可以再追問變化是否集中於某一受眾。這類查詢可協助提出待驗證的假設，換素材或改預算前仍可回查原始報表。
items.title_en: Australia's Bench Media adds ad analysis assistant Aura to Bench Connect
items.summary_en: Australian media agency Bench Media launched Aura inside Bench Connect so marketers can ask questions about campaign data in English.
highlights_en: Aura can compare performance across ad platforms.
Creative and performance teams can investigate signs of creative fatigue and increases in acquisition cost.
items.why_en: Media teams can check whether an anomaly relates to one audience, one asset or the entire campaign before making changes.
items.next_step_en: Test questions on a campaign with a known baseline and reconcile date ranges and conversion definitions against platform reports.
items.detail_en: Mediaweek reports that Bench Connect combines campaign performance, audience and advertising data, which teams can explore in English through Aura. Bench Media's product lead used higher conversions as an example of a change teams can investigate at audience level. Treat the answers as hypotheses and consult the underlying reports before refreshing creative or moving spend.

items.title: 墨西哥Soriana Media採用Kevel，首批廣告版位已上線
items.summary: 零售商Soriana旗下媒體業務選用Kevel提供廣告基礎設施，首批版位已在墨西哥上線。
highlights: 合作公告列出商品贊助、品牌贊助及展示廣告。
雙方計劃陸續擴展Soriana旗下數位渠道可用的廣告格式。
items.why: 欲進入墨西哥零售通路的品牌，可以比較商品曝光和展示廣告在購買前各自覆蓋的接觸點。
items.next_step: 先向Soriana索取已開放版位、商品上架要求和轉換歸因定義，再決定測試預算。
items.detail: Kevel公布，Soriana Media將以零售商自有的購買資料支援廣告，並計劃透過單一平台提供不同格式的報表。公告把直接加購列為技術可支援的例子，僅確認首批版位已上線。品牌可先確認哪種格式實際可買、能否按商品核對數據，以及報表是否涵蓋預定的販售渠道。
items.title_en: Soriana Media turns on first Mexican retail media placements powered by Kevel
items.summary_en: Mexican retailer Soriana's media business selected Kevel for its advertising infrastructure. The first placements are live in Mexico.
highlights_en: The announcement lists sponsored products, sponsored brands and display formats.
The partners plan to expand formats across Soriana's digital channels.
items.why_en: Brands entering Mexican retail can compare where sponsored products and display ads reach shoppers ahead of a purchase.
items.next_step_en: Ask Soriana which placements are bookable, what products qualify and how it defines a conversion before setting a test budget.
items.detail_en: Kevel says Soriana Media will use the retailer's own purchase data to support its ads and plans to report across formats on one platform. The release lists direct add-to-cart as an example of what the technology could support and confirms only the first placements are live. Brands can check which formats are bookable and whether reporting covers their products and sales channels.

items.title: AdTonos更名為Turms，把車內廣告列為早期重點
items.summary: 程式化音訊廣告公司AdTonos更名為Turms，公布以車內等使用情境為重點的Movement Media構想。
highlights: 聯網車輛是早期重點，構想亦涵蓋數位戶外、零售媒體和聯網電視。
擬以情境訊號協助選擇投放時機的AI工具仍在開發，原有音訊業務繼續。
items.why: 規劃車內或跨渠道廣告時，採購團隊可以先釐清可投放的時段、裝置和成效衡量方式。
items.next_step: 索取現有車款、地區、版位及衡量方法清單，再決定是否納入媒體採購規劃。
items.detail: 據PPC Land報道，Turms計劃讓開發中的Movement Media AI評估活動目標、獲准使用的情境訊號、庫存及表現資料，再建議是否適合投放。公布內容未列出現時可採購的跨渠道版位，以及哪些訊號會在車內實際使用。公司表示會繼續為既有音訊客戶及合作夥伴提供支援。
items.title_en: AdTonos rebrands as Turms and makes in-car ads an early priority
items.summary_en: Programmatic audio business AdTonos renamed itself Turms and set out a Movement Media strategy for contexts including connected cars.
highlights_en: Connected vehicles are an early priority. The plan also includes digital out-of-home, retail media and connected TV.
Its AI for choosing when and where ads might run is in development. The existing audio business continues.
items.why_en: Media buyers can clarify eligible times, devices and measurement before planning in-car or cross-channel purchases.
items.next_step_en: Ask for current vehicle, market, placement and measurement lists before putting the option into a media buying plan.
items.detail_en: PPC Land reports that Turms intends its Movement Media AI to evaluate campaign goals, permitted contextual signals, inventory and performance data when deciding whether an ad fits. The announcement leaves current cross-channel inventory and actual in-car signals unspecified. The company says it will continue supporting audio customers and partners.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Sunny Diamonds以女性成就為主題推廣金奈首店
items.summary: Madarth為Sunny Diamonds的金奈首店推出Find Your Shine，將女性的個人成就轉化為珠寶廣告主題。
highlights: 拍攝取材自紅毯和媒體迎拍場景，延伸至戶外、平面和數位媒體。
品牌安排Women Achievers內容系列，並為社群平台剪輯短版。
items.why: 新店行銷可由單一購買情境出發，規劃戶外廣告、店內展示及可持續更新的社群內容。
items.next_step: 以一類顧客的自購情境設計一組開店素材，分別檢查觸及、到店意向和到店紀錄。
items.detail: 據MediaNews4U報道，Sunny Diamonds首間金奈門市於10月31日開幕。Madarth把紅毯概念帶進廣告及開店邀請，並以女性如何看待自己取得的成就為訪談主題。首集Women Achievers已完成拍攝，其他集數及一批戶外版位仍屬計劃。品牌可分別衡量場地及內容的反應。
items.title_en: Sunny Diamonds makes women's achievements the focus of its Chennai launch campaign
items.summary_en: Madarth created Find Your Shine for Sunny Diamonds' first Chennai showroom, using women's personal milestones as the campaign theme.
highlights_en: The shoot borrows from red carpet and paparazzi imagery and runs across outdoor, print and digital.
The Women Achievers series pairs longer interviews with shorter edits for social channels.
items.why_en: Retail launch teams can build outdoor, store and ongoing social content around one specific reason to buy.
items.next_step_en: Design a launch asset set around one self-purchase occasion and track reach, intent to visit and recorded visits separately.
items.detail_en: MediaNews4U reports that the first Chennai showroom opened on October 31. Madarth used the red carpet concept for advertising and invitations and built the interview series around women's own milestones. The first Women Achievers episode has been filmed, with more episodes and outdoor placements planned. Retail teams can measure response to the venue and the content separately.

evidence.audit_status: Issuer announcements, product release notes and direct trade reporting were read and opened again. Availability, market limits, reported events and dates were checked. AI-assisted language review preserved these qualifiers. No human sign-off or product tests.

review_provenance.first_pass: Original company text, official product documentation and dated direct reporting inspected, not headlines alone.
review_provenance.second_pass: Same assistant separately re-retrieved source text to challenge dates, release stages, scope, attribution and unsupported outcomes; individual references retained.

stories.title_zh: illumin推出Ask Lu廣告助理，建案功能開放測試
